title: I Can't Believe This Is Vanilla
description: A modpack for people who are passionate about Minecraft and want a visually appealing experience.
body:
# I Cant Believe This Is Vanilla (ICBTIV)
Well, technically you're right, it's not Vanilla.

If you're passionate about Minecraft and just want to improve the visual experience, this is the perfect mod pack for you.
### 
Thanks to all the modders involved in the mods used, none of this would be possible without you. The modpack was based on Fabulously Optimized, thanks for compiling the mods!
